Two real engine-level fixes made in the course of this migration (both in `functional-model/`, both narrowly scoped, both verified against the real pool before landing):
1. `engine-trace.ts`'s `pilotActivate` now logs a real `{fn:'tap', ...}` entry for a `{T}` COST payment (previously: `engine.ts`'s own `activateAbility` pays it via a bare `engine.state.tap(permanent)` call with NO log line at all — confirmed by reading the real code, not assumed). Without this, a card whose ONLY tap is its own activation cost (Hero's Sundering, `{7}, {T}`, no OTHER tap-shaped effect) has literally zero achievable trace evidence for a `{event:'tap', subject:'self', target:'self'}` fact — unlike Coeurl's own self-tap-cost fact, which only passes today by a coincidence (its own ability effect separately, genuinely retargets itself due to chooseTarget's pool-order limitation in its own scenario). `costRequiresTap`/`activationCostFor` exported from `engine.ts` (were private) to support this. Checked blast radius before landing: 3 other real pool cards call `pilotActivate` with a `{T}`-costed ability (Dion Bahamut's Dominant, Stiltzkin Moogle Merchant, Jill Shiva's Dominant) — none flip from passing to failing (Dion/Jill already show unrelated stale-trace notes; Stiltzkin's synergy.json is still v1-shaped and skipped by verify-synergy.mjs entirely) — a new unexplained 'tap' soft note on those is the same accepted side-effect shape the pump/tap vocabulary promotions already established pool-wide, not a fresh regression class.
2. `definition.ts`'s own two `custom` effects (Hero's Sundering's exile-target, Blessing of Light's counter/keyword/draw) now thread `ctx.preferTarget` through their own `chooseTarget` calls (previously bare `chooseTarget(pool)`, always taking the first pool candidate) — same technique weapons-vendor's/summon-primal-garuda's own `custom` effects already use. Needed for real: without it, Hero's Sundering's own pool order (your own nonland permanents first, then opponents') would always self-target the scenario's OTHER real legendary creature (Freya Crescent) ahead of the intended opponent target (Coeurl), and Blessing of Light's own pool had no way to deterministically land on Freya (the only real creature satisfying the conditional-draw's legendary check) at all.
3. Blessing of Light's own back-face effect now calls `actions.grantKeyword(target, 'Indestructible')` for real (previously: the comment said 'not mechanically enforced,' but `card.ts`'s own `grantKeywordTarget` Effect kind already existed and was simply never wired up for this card — this needed the SAME chosen target as the counter and the conditional draw, which only a `custom` effect's own single `chooseTarget` call can guarantee, so it calls `actions.grantKeyword` directly rather than adding a separate declarative effect).

No baseline self-dies/self-graveyard fact — deliberately, matching dion-bahamut-s-dominant-bahamut-warden-of-light's own real precedent (a similarly-dense, already-migrated DFC) exactly: that card has zero self-mortality fact either, for the same reason — this scenario is already a genuinely dense single continuous playthrough (cast -> cast-trigger -> transform -> combat-trigger) per this task's own 'try 1 scenario before concluding more are needed' standing rule, and adding a real lethal-combat-death sequence (the only way to get real Graveyard-zone trace evidence, since neither face has an onDies-named trigger to claim the DEATH_TRIGGER_NAMES exemption) would substantially bloat it for a fact the task didn't ask for. Real, measured cost of this choice (see find-synergies.mjs diff below): 21 real 'graveyard presence' + 3 real 'dying' matches lost relative to the old v1 file's own self-graveyard/self-dies facts — a real, accepted tradeoff, not an oversight.

Also: an unrelated authoring mistake caught and fixed in this same pass (this card's own scenarios.ts): a helper function typed to return `TraceResult` was returning `[TraceResult]` (an array), then wrapped in another array by `runEngineScenarios` — silently produced a doubly-nested `TraceResult[][]` in trace.json (`vite-node` doesn't type-check at transpile time, so this didn't surface until `verify-synergy.mjs` crashed reading `t.log` off a list instead of an object). Fixed by making the helper return the bare `TraceResult` directly.

2026-09-16 (engine-lane primitive build, coordinator-dispatched): Blessing of Light (back face) migrated off its own kind:'custom' closure onto kind:'program' now that the 2 real, documented blockers are closed: (1) program-ast-walker.ts gained real occurrence support for a bound 'putCounter'/'grantKeyword' EachAction (PutCounterOccurrence/GrantKeywordOccurrence, plus readPool widened to carry excludeSelf forward instead of declining outright), and (2) combinator.ts gained a new bare-player DrawCard ProgramNode (no EachAction variant can act on the player directly, only on a matched Card item) plus a readSubtypeGuardCondition helper so a Branch's own HasSubtypeCondition can gate it. New program: selectUpTo(you.creaturesInPlay().filter('excludeSelf'), 1, 'target', [applyToBound(putCounter), applyToBound(grantKeyword), branch(hasSubtype('target',0,'Legendary'), [drawCard()])]) — same single chosen-target reuse the old custom closure already modeled, now real inspectable data. 3 new sibling recognizers built (putCounterProgram-effect-structural/grantKeywordProgram-effect-structural/drawCardProgram-effect-structural, each with their own .test.ts), wired 3-place (apply-recognizers.mjs/recognizers/types.ts/server/api/recognizer-source/[rule].get.ts). Deleted 2 stale, less-precise pre-existing facts (putCounter/grantKeyword, both missing the real 'another'/excludeSelf narrowing) before rerunning apply-recognizers.mjs so the new, correctly-scoped facts landed instead of a silent same-coreKey retag — also required widening apply-recognizers.mjs's own shared coreKey to add 'excludeSelf' as a real discriminating key (same collision class 'tapped' hit the same day: a top-level SINK excludeSelf field sits outside 'target', previously invisible to coreKey, so a fresh excludeSelf:true sink silently retagged an old excludeSelf-less sink in place without ever gaining the field). apply-recognizers.mjs --slug run: 3 new facts, 2 retagged (the pre-existing bare drawCard fact + the fresh putCounter/grantKeyword/sink set) — back face now 100% recognizer-derived (front face's own 2 unprovenanced transform-exile/return facts are untouched, already documented above as genuinely bespoke). verify-synergy.mjs scoped: 0 hard failures (only pre-existing tapForMana/untap/transform soft notes). npx tsc --noEmit + npx vitest run functional-model: clean. review was already 'ai', nothing to reset.

'Until your next turn, it gains indestructible' (a duration distinct from 'until end of turn') is not tracked as a distinct duration — same accepted state.grantKeyword/layers.ts simplification every other keyword grant in this pool already accepts; the grant is mechanically real, just not time-limited.

'This ability triggers only once each turn' (front trigger) has no per-turn trigger-count enforcement anywhere in this engine — Fact.oncePerTurn:true on both the source drawCard and the sink want is documentary only, same class of gap as elrond-moon-reader's/g-raha-tia's own identical clause.
